chapter.title: Northstar
chapter.subtitle: Start with the Rocket Station and follow the chain

quests.title: Space Program
quests.subtitle: Assemble the heart of your launch site
description: Craft the Rocket Station and Rocket Controls. Rockets are Create contraptions - build the hull from Create blocks and Northstar rocket parts, then superglue the whole assembly.
Next: craft a Rocket Thruster and a Rocket Combustion Chamber.

quests.title: Rocket Parts
quests.subtitle: Thrusters, controls, and a combustion chamber
description: Thrusters, controls, and a combustion chamber turn a pile of blocks into a rocket. The Rocket Station assembles the rocket and sets its destination.
Next: build the oxygen loop so you survive the trip.

quests.title: Oxygen System
quests.subtitle: Life support before liftoff
description: Space has no air. The Oxygen Separator extracts breathable oxygen; the Oxygen Filler refills suits and contraptions. Sealed rooms need an Oxygen Sealer.
Next: craft the Iron Space Suit.

quests.title: Space Suit
quests.subtitle: Sealed, warm, and breathing
description: The Iron Space Suit seals you from vacuum and carries a small oxygen reserve. Wear the full set before launching.
Next: build a telescope and start taking astronomical readings.

quests.title: Science Unlocked
quests.subtitle: Telescopes unlock the sky
description: Astronomical Readings earned with the Telescope are spent at the Astronomy Table as science points. Enough science unlocks new planets in the Space Atlas.
Next: launch for the Moon.

quests.title: Moon Landing
quests.subtitle: One small launch for a demigod
description: Fuel the rocket at the station, climb in, and launch. The Moon has no atmosphere, low gravity, and no mobs - a safe first landing.
Mine lunar sapphire and moon stone. Next: smelt martian iron into Martian Steel.

quests.title: Oxygen Sealer
quests.subtitle: Pressurize your first base
description: Sealed rooms hold their air: place an Oxygen Sealer and it pressurizes the enclosed space. Build a small sealed moon base with a filler.

quests.title: Martian Steel
quests.subtitle: The workhorse metal of the space age
description: Martian Steel is tougher than iron and heat-resistant - the backbone of rockets and bases alike.
Next: land on Mars and mine raw martian iron.

quests.title: Mars
quests.subtitle: Red deserts and hungry worms
description: Mars has a thin atmosphere, orange deserts, and hostile life - Echo Worms, Root Toads, Cobras, Devil Moths. Bring weapons.
Next: mine titanium, which powers the next rocket tier.

quests.title: Titanium
quests.subtitle: Lighter, stronger, essential
description: Titanium replaces iron sheets for advanced crafting and is mined on Mars and Mercury.
Next: survive Mercury's heat and mine tungsten.

quests.title: Mercury
quests.subtitle: Closest to the sun, and it shows
description: Mercury is scorching - heat shielding scales with your rocket's size, and the Martian Steel suit helps. Tungsten ore is here.
Next: smelt tungsten for harder alloys.

quests.title: Tungsten
quests.subtitle: Holds up where everything else melts
description: Tungsten alloys hold up where everything else melts.
Next: Venus - acid plumes, searing heat, and stranger life.

quests.title: Venus
quests.subtitle: The gauntlet
description: Venus is the gauntlet: volcanic ash, exhaust plumes, and mimics hiding among the rocks.
Next: craft the Martian Steel Space Suit for the outer planets.

quests.title: Martian Steel Space Suit
quests.subtitle: Heat-proof everything
description: The Martian Steel suit resists heat far better than iron. With it, the inner planets become routine.
Next: build the Space Atlas and plan your empire.

quests.title: Temperature Regulator
quests.subtitle: Keep your bases habitable
description: Regulate heat and cold in sealed bases - essential for Mercury, Venus, and any planet you want to call home.

quests.title: Space Atlas
quests.subtitle: The map of your empire
description: The Space Atlas tracks every unlocked celestial body and coordinates precise return trips with Return Tickets.
Next: connect your worlds into one empire.

quests.title: Rocket Waypoint
quests.subtitle: Land where you mean to
description: Rocket Waypoints let you land exactly where you want instead of wherever the descent takes you. Mark your bases.

quests.title: Interplanetary Empire
quests.subtitle: The system is yours
description: Bases on Earth, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, and Venus. Ores flow home through Mekanism, AE2 spans the system, and Return Tickets make every trip two-way.
The system is yours.
